# One-way ANOVA: Brush-turkey incubation

This chapter demonstrates one-way ANOVA using incubation-period data from Australian Brush-turkey eggs connected to the University of Queensland St Lucia campus.

## Learning goals

By the end, students should be able to identify the response and factor, interpret an ANOVA table, use post hoc comparisons, and check assumptions using reproducible R code.
